description: This file contains the server-side logic for a web page that displays and updates students' answers and marks for a specific theory exam in an online examination system. It retrieves answers from a database, populates form fields, and allows submission of updated marks.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET page 'ShowAns', handling page load, display of student answers, and submission of updated marks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Checks session variables, retrieves student answers for questions 1-5 from the database, and populates the form fields.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks based on input, updates the database with the new marks and approval status, removes the student's queue entry, and redirects to the course queue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
